newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London follow FTSE higher.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London follow FTSE higher.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London gained ground in muted trade on Thursday, buoyed by the FTSE's climb to record heights and given further support in the afternoon by a firmer Dow and U.S. long bond.
"The market is higher and there are expectations of a rally in the Hong Kong market thanks to a firm FTSE and long bond," one trader said.
By 1529 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference Index was 24.61 points higher at 13,634.94, Traders said the index had been pulled higher by HSBC which was HK$1.00 above its Hong Kong close.
"A very firm FTSE pulled HSBC up and HSBC pulled the rest up," the trader said. "But there hasn't been a lot of turnover in the other stocks."
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index closed moderately lower in cautious trading, ending 82.46 points lower at 13,610.33.
